## Change and reason

Describe the concrete documentation/preservation problem and resulting change.

## Evidence and provenance

Identify retained records, tested build identities, source rights and contributor credit. Distinguish observations, hypotheses and future research.

## Validation

Record the exact checks run and any unavailable holdings.

- [ ] `python scripts/check_repository.py` passes.
- [ ] No frozen runtime/integration source, sealed archive or retained original evidence is rewritten.
- [ ] No runtime experiment, build, capture, native-service or SQL action is introduced without explicit reopening.
- [ ] No credentials, original game/platform binaries, unchecked dependency patches or private evidence are included.
- [ ] Appropriate license notices and sign-off/provenance certification accompany contributed work.
- [ ] Substantial AI assistance is disclosed and independently checked by the responsible contributor.
